caption: The drawing depicts a single elongated metallic object with several distinct features, rendered in shades of black and gray on a plain, light beige background. On the left side, the object has a coiled circular design, next to which is a twisted section terminating in a small loop. The central body of the object is straight and tapers slightly towards the right. The right end of the object curves smoothly into a spiral, ending in a circular plate with three round holes. The overall composition is centered on the page, with no other objects or background elements present. There is a small signature in the lower left corner.
title: Garden Gate Latch
